A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same PLI research. Their main text, equations, figures, tables, and complete appendices support reliable comparison after matching relocated and renumbered content.

before.justification: v1 reports original PLI benchmark evaluations, efficiency measurements, ablations, case studies, and repeated-run results in the main text and appendix.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results, including the benchmark comparisons and appendix analyses.

M1.justification: Section 3 retains the same adjacent-layer spherical interpolation, layer-insertion procedure, and adaptive sigmoid interpolation-ratio scheduling. No method component or inference procedure changes.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate TruthfulQA, FACTOR, StrategyQA, GSM8K, and the same six Open LLM Leaderboard tasks in Table 10. The relocated StrategyQA case study introduces no additional coverage.

E2.justification: Corresponding experiments retain the same Base, ITI, SH2, DoLa, and ICD comparisons, with CD also evaluated on LLAMA2. The interpolation alternatives in Table 3 are unchanged; the newly cited Liang et al. work is not an evaluated baseline.

E3.justification: The model configurations, metrics, insertion positions, hyperparameters, and testing procedures remain unchanged. The appendix model-size and leaderboard experiments also retain their original settings.

E4.justification: The efficiency, interpolation-choice, hidden-state, early-exit, insertion-position, and model-size analyses are retained. v1 Appendix A.3's case study moves to v2 Section 5.5 with the same three examples and analysis.

E5.justification: Both versions report the same five-round significance analysis, uncertainty values, p-values, and significance thresholds in Table 11. Appendix A.8 becomes A.7 without any statistical reporting change.

E6.justification: Matched tables and Figure 3 retain the same numerical results, and the qualitative examples are unchanged. For example, Table 1 reports TruthfulQA MC1 of 63.35 for LLAMA3-8B-Instruct with ICD + PLI in both versions. Tables 6 and 7 exchange numbering without changing their results.

T1.justification: Equations (1)–(8) and their mathematical explanations are unchanged. The theoretical-interpretability discussion moves from Appendix A.5 to A.4 without new assumptions, derivations, or proofs.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about training-free, plug-and-play layer interpolation, factuality improvements, compatibility with existing methods, and connections to internal model mechanisms.

C2.justification: The information-flow interpretation, explanations of interpolation and layer-position effects, and limitations concerning computational overhead and upper-layer redundancy remain unchanged. The relocated case study preserves its original interpretation.

D1.justification: The abstract replaces v1's promise to release code and data upon acceptance with a statement of availability and a specific GitHub repository link. This improves access documentation; implementation details and hardware disclosures in Appendix A.2 remain unchanged.

R1.justification: v2 adds Liang et al. (2024), 'Locate-then-unlearn,' to the introduction's discussion of modifying internal knowledge or representations and to the bibliography. The broader research positioning is unchanged.

P1.justification: v2 moves the case-study prose from Appendix A.3 to Section 5.5, updates associated numbering and references, adds acknowledgements, and changes the contact email and resource-availability sentence. Most prose and the overall narrative remain unchanged.

P2.justification: The case-study table moves from the appendix to the main text as Table 6, while the LLAMA2 results become Table 7. The affiliation block and surrounding text and tables reflow, but the figures and substantive table displays are retained.

improvement.justification: v2 supplies a concrete code/data access link where v1 only promised a future release, modestly improving reproducibility documentation. Moving the existing case study into the main analysis also makes that evidence more prominent. The scientific methods, results, statistical support, and limitations remain unchanged, so the overall gain is limited.
